en: Vintage sepia-toned illustrated postcard showing views from Graz. The main image depicts a tall, multi-story tower with an onion-shaped dome set among trees and hills. Below it is an arched stone structure resembling old fortifications or ruins, with people walking along a path. In a smaller circular vignette on the right, there is an ornate iron pavilion or bandstand with a domed roof in a park, surrounded by trees and figures in late 19th‑century clothing. Decorative lettering at the top right reads "Gruss aus Graz." Publisher and printer information is printed along the lower edges.
